# Fiddler AI
Source: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/observability/fiddler-ai/
Markdown: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/observability/fiddler-ai/index.md
Description: Connect Fiddler AI to GGX with an API key for model observability to monitor, explain, and improve AI systems.

[Fiddler AI](https://www.fiddler.ai/) is a model observability platform to monitor, explain, and improve AI systems. GGX can connect it alongside your other observability tools.

## What it does in GGX

- Make your Fiddler account available to the organization, so users can work with Fiddler from GGX workflows.

## How to connect

1. In GGX, open **Org Settings → Integrations → Observability** and select **Fiddler AI**.
2. Enter your API key and the URL of your Fiddler instance.
3. Save.

## Notes

- A project can use its own credentials instead of the organization's.
